root.osuToolsForPlayers: osu! tools for players, mappers and tournament hosts
root.hellosuHaruhimeHereThese: hellosu, haruhime here. these are free tools i make for osu!: packs turns a mappool into one download, pools is for building and looking up tournament pools, bb is a BBCode editor for userpages and forum posts, harumin is an osu! bot for your Discord server, and tourney runs a tournament from registration to results.

rootNotFound.thatPageDoesnT: That page doesn't exist, or it moved.

signin.oneOsuSignIn: One osu! sign-in for packs, pools and bb. Browsing works without an account.

account.everyHaruhimeAppShows:
Every haruhime app shows dates and times with these. Leave Time zone on "Use my browser's"
          to match where you are; Hour format defaults to 12-hour unless you pick otherwise.
account.oneHaruhimeAccountSigns: One haruhime account signs you in to each of these.
account.everythingHaruhimeAndIts: Everything haruhime and its apps keep about you, as one JSON file.
account.deletes: This deletes your haruhime account and signs you out of packs, pools and bb on every device. It also deletes what you made inside each app. It can't be undone.
